claims.claim: validate prints 'Validating pack', '✓ Schema validation passed', warnings, '✓ Pack structure is valid'; errors exit 1
packc validate validates every file argument, prints 'N of N packs valid' for several, and exits 1 if any fails
schema failures print as '[pack_schema] <path>: <msg>' under '✗ Pack validation failed: <file>'; schema-load failure is a pack_schema error
pack structure checks id, semver version, prompts, template_engine, system_template, prompt version, variables-declared are blocking; missing compilation and undeclared prompt tools are warnings

skill checks: missing dir, path outside the pack dir, SKILL.md parse, duplicate names, inline fields, workflow state skills path errors; allowed-tools warning; @org/name references resolve to the skill install directory and report 'not installed' when absent; relative to config dir (compile) or pack dir (validate)
validate on a missing file reports '[load] reading pack file: open ...'; invalid JSON reports '[load] invalid JSON: ...'
promptarena validate and promptarena export use packc/compiler; promptarena validate adds config consistency and assertion type/param checks
compile prints warnings as '⚠ [stage] message' and fails with 'Compilation failed:'
